tiny-queue

A tiny job queue for Postgres, built on SKIP LOCKED.

Install

npm install tiny-queue
npx tiny-queue migrate

Usage

  1. Create a queue.
  2. Add jobs with enqueue(name, payload).
  3. Run a worker.

See the Postgres docs and mail the maintainer or copy.
